Synopsis:
    Reuters White House correspondent Steve Holland recounts his first-hand experience covering President George W. Bush on September 11, 2001 — from the pre-attack education event in Sarasota, FL, to being stranded as Bush was evacuated, to accompanying him at Ground Zero on September 14. The piece is a personal, journalistic memoir touching on real-time reporting challenges, verification failures, and the emotional weight of the moment. A pure anniversary retrospective with no forward-looking economic or market content.
